## Agility Drills

## 1. Rope or Ladder Routine

Exercise Objective: Develop range of motion of the hips, knees, and ankles, as well as coordination and balance

## 1a. Every Hole

## Procedure

1. Run forward, stepping into every hole with each foot (-23)
2. Drive knees upward for each step
3. Drive arms aggressively in opposition to the legs
4. A slight forward lean is used throughout the drill

## Coaching Points

- The right foot hits every hole on the right side; the left foot hits every hole on the left side
- Keep head up with eyes focused straight ahead (avoid looking down)
